en: A black‑and‑white view down a very narrow, old stone alley with steps in the middle. Tall, aged buildings rise on both sides with peeling plaster. Laundry hangs on lines high above the alley, including a large striped cloth that dominates the scene. An old-style street lamp is fixed to the wall near the steps. At the bottom and side of the stairs stand a few children or young people. Handwritten text appears at the lower left and printed website text at the lower right.
